evidence.quote: The metrics are Source Lines of Code (SLOC) complexity, Cyclomatic Complexity, Nesting Depth Complexity, Cognitive Complexity, and Halstead complexity.
The complexity may be interpreted as implementation difficulty of the code or similarly as the difficulty in understanding the code.
In other words is there a relationship between the code complexity metric and error-proneness of programs measured by the amount of time devs need to find errors.
